I've answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team. The only deadline on record for the signed Tansley Parcel order form is 25 August. Pree posted it in that channel on 14 October.

I suggested he check the year with Pree before putting it on the account sheet. She didn't give one, and 25 August this year has already passed. I asked her on the 14th whether she meant next August or whether the deadline had slipped, and she hasn't replied yet. There's also no Tansley Parcel order form in the share to check it against.

A signing deadline isn't a money term, and Hollis leads the Central team and is in that channel, so it was fine to share there.
